questions.q: Against whom did Yahweh tell Ezekiel to prophesy?
questions.a: Yahweh told Ezekiel to prophesy against Gog from the land of Magog.

questions.q: With what does Yahweh say he will send out Gog?
questions.a: Yahweh says he will send out Gog with all his army, horses, and horsemen.

questions.q: Who is the commander of all the troops from Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer, and Beth Togarmah?
questions.a: Gog is the commander of all these troops assembled with him.

questions.q: To which land will Gog be called to go?
questions.a: Gog will go to a land that has recovered from the sword and that has been gathered from many peoples to the mountains of Israel.

questions.q: What will be the wicked scheme that Gog devises?
questions.a: Gog will devise a scheme to capture booty and steal plunder from the quiet people living in safety.

questions.q: At what part of the earth are the people who have been gathered from the nations living?
questions.a: The people gathered from the nations are living at the center of the earth.

questions.q: From what direction does Gog and his great army come?
questions.a: Gog and his great army come from a place far away in the north.

questions.q: Through whom had Yahweh spoken that Gog would come against Israel?
questions.a: Yahweh had spoken through the prophets of Israel that Gog would come against Israel.

questions.q: How will Yahweh respond when Gog attacks the land of Israel?
questions.a: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, Yahweh will respond with fury in his nostrils.

questions.q: What great event does Yahweh say will happen on the day Gog attacks Israel?
questions.a: Yahweh says that there will be a great earthquake on the day Gog attacks Israel.

questions.q: With what will Yahweh judge Gog and his troops on that day?
questions.a: Yahweh will judge Gog and his troops on that day with plague, blood, flooding rains, hailstones of fire, and rains of brimstone.

questions.q: In that day, what will Yahweh show in the eyes of many nations?
questions.a: In that day, Yahweh will show his greatness and holiness in the eyes of many nations.

commentary.text: The army and malice of Gog. (Ezek. 38:1-13) God's judgments. (Ezek. 38:14-23)

Ezek. 38:1-13 These events will be in the latter days. It is supposed these enemies will come together to invade the land of Judea, and God will defeat them. God not only sees who are now the enemies of his church, but he foresees who will be so, and lets them know by his word that he is against them; though they join together, the wicked shall not be unpunished.

Ezek. 38:14-23 The enemy should make a formidable descent upon the land of Israel. When Israel dwell safely under the Divine protection, shalt not thou be made to know it by finding that endeavours to destroy them are made in vain? Promises of security are treasured up in the word of God, against the troubles and dangers the church may be brought into in the latter days. In the destruction of sinners, God makes it appear that he is a great and holy God. We should desire and pray daily. Father, glorify thine own name.
